concepts.title: Hölder’s inequality
concepts.description: For measurable functions f_i and exponents p_i∈[1,∞] with ∑_i1/p_i=1, ∫|∏_if_i|dμ≤∏_i‖f_i‖_{p_i}.

concepts.title: Hörmander smooth-density theorem for diffusions
concepts.description: For bounded smooth Stratonovich diffusion fields satisfying the parabolic Hörmander bracket condition, the transition law at positive time has a smooth density with respect to Lebesgue measure. A full-rank invariant open region may be used in place of the whole Euclidean space.

concepts.title: Householder reflection
concepts.description: For a nonzero real vector v, the orthogonal reflection H=I−2vvᵀ/(vᵀv) fixes the hyperplane perpendicular to v and negates v. Applying H to a vector uses O(n) arithmetic operations.

concepts.title: Householder completion preserving leading orthogonal columns
concepts.description: Given the first k orthonormal columns of an n×n orthogonal transform, successive Householder transformations on trailing coordinates yield an orthogonal matrix with exactly these columns. Applying its k factors costs O(nk), while the ANOVA variance attributed to the first k transformed Gaussian coordinates agrees with that of any orthogonal completion of those columns.

concepts.title: Hypergraph-correlated random variables
concepts.description: For a finite hypergraph (V,E), an E-indexed family Y_e is hypergraph-correlated if independent underlying variables X_v exist with each Y_e a measurable function only of (X_v)_{v∈e}.

concepts.title: Identity theorem for holomorphic functions
concepts.description: Two holomorphic functions on a connected complex domain that agree on a set with an accumulation point inside the domain agree everywhere.

concepts.title: Coexistence curve and critical point of the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: For the variational function in the pressure theorem, there is a critical endpoint m_c=2−√2,J_c=(3+2√2)/4,h_c=½log(2√2−2)−¼. A coexistence curve h=γ(J),J>J_c, has exactly two distinct nondegenerate global maximizers. Off that curve the global maximizer is unique; at the endpoint its second and third derivatives vanish and fourth derivative is negative. Away from the curve and endpoint it is nondegenerate.

concepts.title: Monomer-density limit and phase coexistence in the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: In the complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer model define g(z)=eᶻ(√(e²ᶻ+4)−eᶻ)/2, p₀(z)=−(1−g(z))/2−½log(1−g(z)), and F(m)=−Jm²+p₀((2m−1)J+h). If F has a unique global maximizer m*, then S_N/N converges in distribution to m*. On the coexistence curve, where its two nondegenerate global maxima are m₁<m₂, the limit is ρ₁δ_{m₁}+ρ₂δ_{m₂}, with ρ_l proportional to [−F″(m_l)(2−m_l)]⁻¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Gaussian and quartic monomer-count fluctuations in the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: For the complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer model with J>0, let F and its unique maximizer m* be as in the density-limit theorem. Away from coexistence and the critical endpoint, (S_N−Nm*)/√N converges to N(0,−1/F″(m*)−1/(2J)). At the critical endpoint, F″=F‴=0,F⁽⁴⁾<0 and (S_N−Nm*)/N³ᐟ⁴ converges to the density proportional to exp(F⁽⁴⁾(m*)x⁴/24). For J=0 the Gaussian limit has mean-density g(h) and variance g′(h).

concepts.title: Variational pressure theorem for the imitative monomer–dimer model
concepts.description: For complete-graph imitative monomer–dimer parameters h∈ℝ,J≥0, let g(z)=eᶻ(√(e²ᶻ+4)−eᶻ)/2 and p₀(z)=−(1−g(z))/2−½log(1−g(z)). Then lim_NN⁻¹logZ_N=max_{m∈[0,1]}{−Jm²+p₀(h+(2m−1)J)}.

concepts.title: Imitative monomer–dimer model on the complete graph
concepts.description: On matchings D of K_N, let S(D)=N−2|D| be the monomer count. With external field h∈ℝ and coupling J≥0, assign D probability proportional to N^{−|D|}exp((h−J)S(D)+JS(D)²/N). This is the complete-graph monomer–dimer model with attractive imitative interaction.

concepts.title: Independence system
concepts.description: A finite set V and a nonempty family I of subsets of V closed under taking subsets.

concepts.title: Independent set in a hypergraph
concepts.description: A set of vertices containing no hyperedge.

concepts.title: Independent σ-algebras
concepts.description: A family of sub-σ-algebras is independent if the probability of the intersection of events from any finite subfamily equals the product of their probabilities.

concepts.title: Injective function
concepts.description: A function f is injective if f(x)=f(y) implies x=y for all points of its domain.

concepts.title: Integration by parts for real integrals
concepts.description: For continuously differentiable u,v on [a,b], ∫_a^buv′=[uv]_a^b−∫_a^bu′v; improper variants follow when boundary terms and integrals converge.

concepts.title: Interlacing of real-rooted polynomials
concepts.description: The real zeros of degree-n and degree-(n−1) real-rooted polynomials interlace if, when listed with multiplicity, α₁≤β₁≤α₂≤⋯≤β_{n−1}≤α_n.

concepts.title: Interlacing and positive partial fractions
concepts.description: If p,q are monic real polynomials of degrees d,d−1 with real roots weakly interlacing, then after cancellation q/p has only simple real poles and a partial-fraction expansion∑_jc_j/(z−r_j), with c_j≥0. A denominator root of multiplicity m cancels at least m−1 times. Conversely such a ratio gives weak interlacing after reinserting common real factors.
